root_cause: A connected LinkedIn account was being treated as sufficient evidence for both personal and company publishing even though organization publishing can require separate administrator roles and OAuth scopes.
prevention: Read the active Composio LinkedIn account before any LinkedIn provider side effect.
Prove personal author identity with LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO.
Prove organization publishing capability separately with LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO and approved administrator access.
Never infer company-page write access from personal LinkedIn connectivity alone.
Keep capability discovery read-only; only the canonical social publisher may own write side effects.
